=== Format for adding a new example ===
 * ''Description''
 <span style="background-color:#bbb"> </span>type{{tc|#555|'':subtype''}} {{tc|#555|''things:''}}<nowiki>''material''</nowiki>{{tc|#555|'':things''}}
Be sure to:
* Include a space before the command to format it correctly
* Copy the command as it would appear in DFHack, leaving out the initial <code>createitem</code> and quantity
* Use two single quotes (<code>'</code>) around the part of the command that can vary (e.g. type of animal, tree, metal, etc.)
* For commands with multiple parts that can vary (e.g. "createitem FISH FISH_SHAD:MALE"), include both parts in italics (e.g. "createitem FISH ''creature:caste''").
